footer.lead: OpenDefence is an FDF-guided national defence open-source project that aims to offer multi-domain-operation-capable C2 services to soldiers in an easy and interoperable way.
footer.core: The core of the stack is Deploy App.
footer.easyBody: It gives soldiers the ability to easily share and gain access to their unit's services.
footer.interopBody: For us, interoperability is not a marketing slogan. Deploy App offers developers an integration interface: integrate your product into the app, and we can deploy it to soldiers — working together with the other products.
footer.maintain: OpenDefence develops and maintains a couple of official product integrations and user guides, as shown here. The products themselves are made by their original developers, such as the TAK Product Center.
